clips.title: The story
paras: The Agamand Family Mace is an ancestral heirloom preserved within the Agamand Family Crypt in northern Tirisfal Glades. Once a symbol of pride for a wealthy dynasty of northern Lordaeron, it has become an object of spiteful retribution sought by their former servant Coleman Farthing.

Before the Third War, the Agamand family held extensive farmlands and windmills in the northern reaches of Tirisfal Glades. Like the rest of the regional aristocracy, they fell before the plague of undeath. The Agamands were reanimated as mindless thralls in service to the Lich King, wandering their ruined estate while their ancient family treasures remained locked within the depths of the family crypt. The Agamand Family Mace is stored among these weapons, an emblem of a forgotten lineage now reduced to shambling Scourge.
